Let’s explore the importance, benefits and coverage details of overseas health insurance and guide you on how to buy international health insurance effectively.

sections.heading: What does International Health Insurance typically cover?
sections.text: Hospitalisation, outpatient care, daycare procedures, ambulance costs, preventive check-ups, mental health treatment, and in some plans, modern therapies, palliative care, or rehabilitation.

sections.heading: What documents are required for an International Health Insurance claim?
sections.text: Claim form, hospital bills, prescriptions, test reports, discharge summaries, and for accident-related claims, a police report.

sections.heading: What are the common reasons for International Health Insurance claim rejection?
sections.text: Incomplete paperwork, false information, excluded treatments, undisclosed pre-existing conditions, or fraudulent claims.

sections.heading: Is emergency evacuation covered under International Health Insurance claims?
sections.text: Yes. Many plans cover emergency medical evacuation when treatment is unavailable locally, including air ambulance or transfers to suitable facilities within policy limits.

chunks.text: Claim form, hospital bills, prescriptions, test reports, discharge summaries, and for accident-related claims, a police report.

chunks.heading: What are the common reasons for International Health Insurance claim rejection?
chunks.text: Incomplete paperwork, false information, excluded treatments, undisclosed pre-existing conditions, or fraudulent claims.

chunks.heading: Is emergency evacuation covered under International Health Insurance claims?
chunks.text: Yes. Many plans cover emergency medical evacuation when treatment is unavailable locally, including air ambulance or transfers to suitable facilities within policy limits.
